question: Which is the largest inland saline wetland in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Sambhar Lake**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sambhar Lake** is the largest inland saline wetland in **India**.
 
• It is located in the state of **Rajasthan**, near the towns of Sambhar, Jaipur, and Ajmer.
 
• The lake covers an area of around **190 to 230 square kilometers**, depending on the season.
 
• Sambhar Lake is a major source of **salt production** in India, contributing significantly to the salt industry.
 
• The lake is fed by several rivers, including the **Mendha, Rupangarh, Khari, and Khandela** rivers.
 
• It is recognized as a **Ramsar site**, which designates it as a wetland of international importance.
 
• The lake is also a key ecological habitat for migratory birds, including the **flamingos, pelicans, and storks**.
 
• The saline nature of the lake is due to the high concentration of **salt deposits** formed over time.
 
• Sambhar Lake has significant cultural and religious importance, being mentioned in ancient Indian texts like the **Mahabharata**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Wular Lake**__

 __
 
• **Wular Lake** is one of the largest freshwater lakes in **India**.
 
• It is located in the state of **Jammu and Kashmir**.
 
• The lake is fed by the **Jhelum River** and is important for fisheries and agriculture.
 
• It plays a crucial role in maintaining the **hydrological balance** of the region.
 
 
 
• **Pulicat Lake**__
 __
 
• **Pulicat Lake** is a brackish water lagoon located on the border of **Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu**.
 
• It is the second-largest lagoon in India after the **Chilika Lake**.
 
• The lake is known for its **bird sanctuary**, which attracts migratory birds like flamingos.
 
 
 
• **Chilika Lake**__
 
 
• **Chilika Lake** is the largest coastal lagoon in **India** and is located in the state of **Odisha**.
 
• It is a major habitat for **aquatic life** and migratory birds.
 
• The lake is designated as a **Ramsar site** and is known for its rich biodiversity.
